entries.expected_signal: Test 2 (QSA + trailing ?): BEFORE sets QSNONE, AFTER does NOT set QSNONE. KEY ASSERTION: QSA+trailing? correctly does not set QSNONE in new code.

contracts.detail: Contract: When RULEFLAG_QSAPPEND is set AND trailing ? is present, RULEFLAG_QSNONE must NOT be set. Verified across 6 test cases. Old (regressed) behavior: QSNONE unconditionally set regardless of QSA. New (fixed) behavior: QSNONE only set when QSA is NOT present. All 6 tests passed with exact match.

behavior_differences.before: flags=0x00100200 (RULEFLAG_QSAPPEND | RULEFLAG_QSNONE). QSNONE set unconditionally, overriding QSA.
behavior_differences.after: flags=0x00000200 (RULEFLAG_QSAPPEND only). QSNONE NOT set, QSA preserved. Query string will be appended at runtime.
behavior_differences.evidence: gcov confirmed apply_trailing_qmark_AFTER line 21 (if !QSAPPEND) and line 22 (set QSNONE) executed. Line 21 taken both branches: 3x QSAPPEND not set -> line 22 executed; 3x QSAPPEND set -> line 22 skipped.
